nightsiege.guide.archer.body:
Trunk: §eAim§r (more arrow damage), then §eLight Foot§r or §eQuiver Keeper§r.

Then you pick one of two §6ways§r. Every tier is a choice. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way, nodes marked ◎ are hunter skills (Mark, The Hunt) found in both ways. The bonuses only work with the weapon of your way.

## Way of the Bow
- Punch Through for both, then §eQuickshot§r or §eHeavy Shot§r
- Talents: Double Shot, Volley, Impale, Heavy Arrow, Fire Arrows, Poison Tips, Eagle Eye, Fall Back
- Ultimate §eArrow Storm§r, §ePower Shot§r or §eThe Hunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_bow|Class item: Infernite Bow

## Way of the Crossbow
- Heavy Bolts for both, then §eBolter§r (shrapnel) or §eTrapper§r (nets)
- Talents: Explosive Bolts, Multiload, Snare Net, Shackle Bolts, Punch Shot, Tripwire, Braced, Reload Rush
- Ultimate §eBolt Volley§r, §eNet Rain§r or §eThe Hunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_crossbow|Class item: Infernite Crossbow
nightsiege.guide.archer.title: Archer
nightsiege.guide.bonus.body:
Between sieges something good happens now and then.

## Aurora
@minecraft:glow_ink_sac|In about one quiet night in eight (no siege due) an aurora dances in the sky. Within 64 blocks of a core it slowly heals you and grants 1 experience point every minute.

## Trader caravan
@minecraft:emerald|Every few days a caravan with two llamas may stop at the core in the morning. It stays one day and sells for emeralds:
- 4 of the traps, 2 each
- Dungeon maps
- 4 good things, e.g. golden apples, ender pearls, diamonds, bottles o' enchanting, a totem or a Mending book
nightsiege.guide.bonus.title: Special events
nightsiege.guide.classes.body:
Every player picks one of four classes. The choice is permanent, but you can change it §eonce§r at the core (button "Change class"): all your points come back. You can look at the other classes any time.

## Experience
- 1 point for every attacker you kill
- 10 points for a champion
- For a survived night: 1 point plus 1 per 5 levels

## The tree
Every class has its own star map: the trunk in the middle, a way with two subclasses to the left and to the right. Every ring is a tier, and you pick one node per tier. Coloured nodes belong to a subclass, light ones to both. The mouse wheel zooms in and out, a click shows everything about a node on the right, a double click learns it. Everyone sees your subclass next to your name.

## When skills work
- During a siege
- Always in creative
- Always while you hold or wear the infernite item of your path
nightsiege.guide.classes.title: Classes & Skills
nightsiege.guide.commands.body:
## For everyone
- /nightsiege info - state and level
- /nightsiege cores - known cores
- /nightsiege skills - your skills
- /nightsiege mobs - the monster list

## Admins only (OP)
- /nightsiege start - start a siege now
- /nightsiege stop - abort the siege
- /nightsiege test <level> [normal|blutmond|champion|thema|finsternis|nebel|gewitter|netherriss|frost] - test siege, does not count
- /nightsiege reload - reload the settings
- /nightsiege ereignis polarlicht | polarlicht_ende | karawane - trigger a special event
- /nightsiege dungeon list - all dungeon kinds and perks
- /nightsiege dungeon tp <kind> - to the nearest dungeon of that kind
- /nightsiege dungeon start <kind> [waves] [tier] - test fight, does not count
- /nightsiege dungeon reset [kind] - make dungeons playable again
- /nightsiege dungeon perk <perk> <stage> - set a perk stage

## Creative only
- /nightsiege dev <points> - grant experience
- /nightsiege dev reset - reset your class
nightsiege.guide.commands.title: Commands
nightsiege.guide.core.body:
@nightsiege:siege_core|The core replaces the bed as the heart of your base.

- The first player of a world gets one for free
- Recipe: nether star in the middle, 4 diamond blocks on the sides, 4 obsidian in the corners
- Right click opens the core window with the situation, the classes and the core tree

## The countdown
The clock only runs while at least §e3 players§r are within §e300 blocks§r of the core. Between two sieges lie 2 to 5 in-game days of that time.

## The core tree
The core has its own skill tree that everyone pays for together. Donate experience with the button on the core tab.
- Watchtower: monsters spawn further away
- Fortified: more time between waves
nightsiege.guide.core.title: The Core
nightsiege.guide.dungeons.body:
§cDungeons are switched off for now§r, until fitting structures are found (admins can switch them back on in the config with dungeonsEnabled).

Dungeon cores hide in the structures of other mods, roughly in every second or third one.

@nightsiege:dungeon_core|Come within §e24 blocks§r and the core awakens: a sound, a beam of light, a hint above the hotbar.

## The fight
- §eRight-click§r the core to start it
- All players within 32 blocks join in; more players bring more monsters
- 1 to 3 waves depending on the structure; a §dguardian§r waits in the last one
- Monster strength depends on the structure and your spent class points
- Monsters fit the structure: undead in ruins, pillagers in fortresses, drowned at sea, fire in the Nether

## Defeat and victory
- If everyone falls or moves more than 48 blocks away, the fight is lost. Try again after §e5 minutes§r
- Won: everyone gets a §dcore fragment§r of the structure, one of vigilance for the guardian and a dungeon map
- A beaten dungeon stays beaten and its core goes dark

## Dungeon maps
@nightsiege:dungeon_map|Used, the map leads to the nearest dungeon in unexplored land. Get them from the cartographer (journeyman: 12 emeralds + compass), in chests, as dungeon rewards and with some luck after a won siege.

## Testing in creative
@nightsiege:dungeon_compass|The dungeon compass lists every dungeon kind: travel there, test here (waves, tier, progress, guardian and theme are free to set) and reset. Tests give no reward.

nightsiege.guide.engineer.body:
Trunk: §eSpike Trap§r and §eSnare Trap§r, plus §eBattery§r or §eFine Mechanics§r.

§6Remote control§r (every engineer gets one): right-click one of your traps to overcharge it (5 s of double strength and speed), right-click a monster to mark it (your turrets aim at it first). Sneak + right-click sets off mines, flame and poison traps from afar or reloads a trap. Every order costs energy (the blue bar), which comes back by itself. Talents marked ↔ give you a trap of the other way at tier 2.

## Way of Mechanics
- Circuit for both, then the subclass §eGunner§r (arrow turret) or §eElectrician§r (tesla coil)
- Talents: Turret Tuning, Ammo Belt, Capacitor, Chain Bolt, Seeker, Overvolt, Backup Power, Watchtower
- Ultimate §eOvercharge§r or §eThunderstorm§r, then a mastery and a keystone

## Way of Chemistry
- Detonator for both, then the subclass §eDemolition§r (blast mine) or §eAlchemist§r (poison trap)
- Talents: Flame Trap, Shrapnel Mine, Toxic Brew, Acid Slime, Chain Reaction, Accelerant, Blast Power, Creeping Poison
- Ultimate §eBombardment§r or §eToxic Cloud§r, then a mastery and a keystone

@nightsiege:remote_control|Remote control: energy refills by itself
@nightsiege:infernite_pickaxe|Class item for both ways: Infernite Pickaxe

Every siege hands out free traps - but only up to the cap.

nightsiege.guide.guardian.body:
Trunk: §eVitality§r (hearts), then §eChallenger§r (aggro) or §eToughness§r (armour).

Every guardian draws monsters that attack teammates. Raise the shield just before a hit for a §6perfect block§r: the attacker is stunned. Damage you take and healing on teammates earn points like kills. §6Shield action§r: left-click while blocking. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way.

## Way of the Shield (bonuses only with a shield)
- Shield Wall for both, then the subclass §eShieldbearer§r (riposte, in exchange 3 s of blocking at most) or §eBulwark§r (bastion)
- Talents: Shield Throw, Shield Bash, Iron Hide, Anchor, Counterstrike, Thorns, Last Stand, Revenge
- Ultimate §eShield Charge§r or §eTaunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_shield|Class item: Infernite Shield or Infernite Chestplate

## Way of Blessing (healing and shielding)
- Field Dressing for both, then the subclass §eMedic§r (Healing Hand) or §eWarden§r (barriers)
- Talents: Guardian Angel, Triage, Shield Dome, Cleanse, Lightbringer, Selfless, Overflow, Grace
- Ultimate §eMass Heal§r or §eHoly Sanctuary§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_helmet|Class item: Infernite Helmet (worn)

nightsiege.guide.intro.body:
Night Siege turns your base into a fortress that has to be defended.

At its centre stands the core. While enough players are near it, a countdown runs. When it ends, waves of monsters attack at night - a little stronger every time.

## How to play
- Place the core and build your base around it
- Pick a class and earn experience from kills
- Buy skills, unlock your ult, survive the sieges
- Endgame: find infernite and forge your class gear

Open this handbook any time with §eH§r (rebindable under Controls), with the handbook item, or from the tab in the core window.
nightsiege.guide.intro.title: Overview
nightsiege.guide.perks.title: Core Perks
nightsiege.guide.siege.body:
At sunset a horn warns you. At night the siege begins: every player within 120 blocks becomes a defender.

## How it goes
- A new wave arrives every 38 seconds
- A night lasts 4 to 10 minutes, depending on the level
- Survive until the end and the siege is won

## Level
The level rises with every win and every 8 in-game days (up to 20). Monsters get tougher and stronger and new kinds join - from zombies to ravagers with riders and monsters from Friends & Foes, Variants & Ventures and It Takes a Pillage.

## Digging
@minecraft:iron_pickaxe|Monsters with a pickaxe break stone
@minecraft:iron_axe|Monsters with an axe break wood
Monsters without a tool do not dig. Bedrock and containers are always safe.

## Defeat
If every defender falls, the area around the core explodes (radius 12). Chests and bedrock survive and the core stays - but the level and all skill trees are reset.

nightsiege.guide.ult.body:
The last node of every path is an ult - a strong ability at the press of a key.

- Fire it with §eR§r (rebindable under Options → Controls → Night Siege)
- Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 seconds by rank
- A slot right of the hotbar shows the ult, the key above it and the cooldown
- Greyed out means: not active right now (outside a siege)

## Reward
Bring your ult to its top rank and you receive an §dInfernite Smithing Template§r, once.
nightsiege.guide.ult.title: Ults
nightsiege.guide.warrior.body:
Trunk: §eDrill§r (more melee damage), then §eEndurance§r or §eFootwork§r.

Then you pick one of two §6ways§r. Every tier is a choice: one node per tier. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way, replace your own and close some later ones. Hybrid slots only appear for fitting combinations. The bonuses only work with the weapon of your way.

## Way of the Blade (swords)
- Champion's Bane for both, then the subclass §eBlademaster§r (crits) or §eBerserker§r (bloodlust)
- Talents: Combo, Precision, Blood Drinker, War Cry, Parry, Frenzy, Evasion, Blood Price
- Ultimate §eExecute§r or §eWhirlwind§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_sword|Class item: Infernite Sword

## Way of Might (axes, maces)
- Shatter for both, then the subclass §eAxe Fighter§r (heavy blow) or §ePaladin§r (consecration against the undead)
- Talents: Cleave, Headhunter, Holy Thirst, Vow, Momentum, Aura of Blessing, Earth Shock, Divine Shield
- Ultimate §eGround Slam§r or §eHoly Light§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_axe|Class item: Infernite Axe or Infernite Mace

nightsiege.skill.g_hedgehog.desc: While anchored your thorns hit every monster around you three times as hard.
nightsiege.skill.g_iron_will.desc: While taunting your bastion works in full and you get twice the extra hearts.
nightsiege.skill.g_ironhide.desc: Every 5 s: 1 heart of absorption for every monster within 5 blocks (up to 4 hearts).
nightsiege.skill.g_laststand.desc: Below 30 % health you get 4 s of Resistance II. At most every 30 s.
nightsiege.skill.g_lifebond.desc: When your barrier breaks on a player, it heals them 1.5 hearts.
nightsiege.skill.g_lifespring.desc: Mass heal leaves a healing spring for 6 s.
nightsiege.skill.g_lightbringer.desc: Your heal aura reaches 4 blocks further.
nightsiege.skill.g_lightcircle.desc: In the sanctuary monsters burn, the undead are hurt and players heal.
nightsiege.skill.g_miracle.desc: The Healing Hand also gives a barrier of 2 hearts.
nightsiege.skill.g_overflow.desc: Healing beyond full health turns into absorption (up to 3 hearts).
nightsiege.skill.g_patron.desc: Barriers are 50 % stronger, but 2 hearts less.
nightsiege.skill.g_rampart.desc: The shield charge hurls monsters far away and stuns them.
nightsiege.skill.g_rebirth.desc: Mass heal removes bad effects and readies your guardian angel again.
nightsiege.skill.g_revenge.desc: Half the damage you take charges your next hit (up to +8).
nightsiege.skill.g_saint.desc: +40 % healing, but you deal 30 % less damage.
nightsiege.skill.g_sanctuary.desc: Ult: A sanctuary (8 blocks, 6 s). Players inside take 60 % less damage, monsters stay out. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.g_selfless.desc: When you heal others you heal yourself for 30 % of it too.
nightsiege.skill.g_shared_burden.desc: Taunt gives teammates resistance and a barrier.
nightsiege.skill.g_shieldbash.desc: A perfect block throws back everything in front of you (5 damage).
nightsiege.skill.g_shieldthrow.desc: Shield action: the shield bounces between 3 monsters (6 damage each) and comes back. 8 s rest.
nightsiege.skill.g_shieldwall.desc: Blocked hits give you absorption (up to 2 hearts). With the riposte you block 0.5 s longer per level.
nightsiege.skill.g_thorns.desc: Monsters that hit you in melee take 2 damage.
nightsiege.skill.g_triage.desc: Healing on players below 40 % health works twice.
nightsiege.skill.g_vengeance.desc: When your iron hide breaks, or on a perfect block with Shield Bash: a shock wave with 6 damage all around.
nightsiege.skill.g_ward.desc: Every 8 s the weakest player within 12 blocks (you too) gets a barrier. Stronger per level.
nightsiege.skill.g_wardsign.desc: Players within 6 blocks take 4 % less damage per level.
nightsiege.skill.g_wellspring.desc: The shield dome heals the players inside.
nightsiege.skill.ground_slam.desc: Ult: You throw everything around you into the air and stun it. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.guardian_angel.desc: Once a night it saves a teammate within 24 blocks from death.
nightsiege.skill.heavy_blow.desc: Your hits deal more damage and slow the target.
nightsiege.skill.heavy_draw.desc: Arrows hit harder, with a short pause after each shot.
nightsiege.skill.holy_light.desc: Ult: Holy light burns the undead and heals teammates. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.hunt.desc:
Ult: marks every monster
far around you.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.impale.desc:
Spear hits also strike
the monster behind.
nightsiege.skill.lance_thrust.desc:
Ult: runs through everything
in a line of 8 blocks.
Ult key (default R).
nightsiege.skill.m_cross_rage.desc: The less health you have, the more damage you deal (up to +60 %).
nightsiege.skill.mass_heal.desc: Ult: Strongly heals every player within 12 blocks. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.overcharge.desc: Ult: Your turrets fire three times as fast for a while. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.poison_trap.desc: A toxic cloud poisons and weakens monsters; the undead wither. Higher tiers: stronger, larger, more often.
nightsiege.skill.power_shot.desc: Ult: Your next shot hits three times as hard. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.riposte.desc: Blocked hits throw back 1.5 damage per level, perfect blocks double. In exchange you block 3 s at most, then the shield rests 2 s.
nightsiege.skill.s_cross_dressing.desc: Every 3 s you heal the players near you a little.
nightsiege.skill.s_cross_ward.desc: Every 8 s the weakest player within 12 blocks gets a barrier (2 hearts).
nightsiege.skill.shield_charge.desc: Ult: You charge ahead and ram everything in front of you away. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.shrapnel.desc: Bolts splinter onto the monsters next to the target.
nightsiege.skill.snare_trap.desc: When a monster steps on it, every monster around is held in place. Higher tiers: larger, longer, ready sooner.
nightsiege.skill.spike_trap.desc: Floor plate: hurts and slows monsters walking over it. Higher tiers: more damage, lasts longer.
nightsiege.skill.sunder.desc: Monsters you hit take more damage for a moment.
nightsiege.skill.swift_draw.desc: Short draws hit almost as hard as full ones.
nightsiege.skill.taunt.desc: Ult: Every monster around attacks you. You harden and your team gets extra hearts. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.tesla_coil.desc: Lightning jumps from monster to monster. Needs no ammunition. Higher tiers: more jumps and range.
nightsiege.skill.thunderstorm.desc: Ult: Chain lightning from your hand jumps across many monsters. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.toxic_cloud.desc: Ult: Poisons every monster around you. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.tracker.desc:
Monsters you hit glow
and take more damage.
nightsiege.skill.w_aftershock.desc: A second later you slam the ground again.
nightsiege.skill.w_bladefrenzy.desc: Critical hits give you strength for a moment.
nightsiege.skill.w_blessing.desc: Heals you and teammates within 8 blocks again and again.
nightsiege.skill.w_bloodprice.desc: +30 % melee damage, but every hit costs half a heart (never below 3 hearts).
nightsiege.skill.w_bloodstorm.desc: The whirlwind heals you for every monster it hits.
nightsiege.skill.w_bloody_execute.desc: The execution heals you 3 hearts and gives regeneration.
nightsiege.skill.w_chain_execute.desc: The execution jumps to up to 2 more wounded monsters.
nightsiege.skill.w_cleave.desc: 40 % of the damage also hits the monsters next to the target.
nightsiege.skill.w_combo.desc: Quick hits in a row: +8 % damage each, up to +40 %.
nightsiege.skill.w_crater.desc: The ground slam pulls monsters to you and holds them.
nightsiege.skill.w_crusader.desc: Cleave hits heal you and set the undead on fire.
nightsiege.skill.w_divine_shield.desc: Every 30 s one heavy hit is caught completely.
nightsiege.skill.w_earthshock.desc: Hits while falling deal +60 % damage and hit everything around.
nightsiege.skill.w_evasion.desc: 10 % chance to dodge a monster's damage completely.
nightsiege.skill.w_frenzy.desc: The less health you have, the faster you swing.
nightsiege.skill.w_headsman.desc: Critical hits deal +4 damage and stun briefly.
nightsiege.skill.w_heavyswing.desc: You swing axes and maces faster.
nightsiege.skill.w_holy_strike.desc: Critical hits set the undead on fire and heal you.
nightsiege.skill.w_martyr.desc: You heal teammates around you a lot, but have 2 hearts less yourself.
nightsiege.skill.w_momentum.desc: After a kill your next hit deals double damage.
nightsiege.skill.w_parry.desc: 15 % chance to catch a blow and strike back.
nightsiege.skill.w_precision.desc: Critical hits deal +100 % instead of +50 % damage.
nightsiege.skill.w_redemption.desc: Holy light heals much more and removes bad effects.
nightsiege.skill.w_sunfire.desc: Holy light burns longer and hits the undead harder.
nightsiege.skill.w_unstoppable.desc: No knockback and no slowness, but 10 % slower.
nightsiege.skill.w_vow.desc: You and teammates within 6 blocks take less damage.
nightsiege.skill.w_warcry.desc: Monsters within 5 blocks are weakened again and again.
nightsiege.skill.whirlwind.desc: Ult: You hit everything around you and fling it away. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.x_cross_double.desc: A second bolt flies with every shot.
nightsiege.skill.x_hunt.desc: Ult: Marks every monster far around you. Ult key: R.
nightsiege.skill.x_mark.desc: Monsters you hit glow and take 25 % more damage from everyone.
nightsiege.skill.x_pack.desc: The hunt reaches further, slows the monsters and speeds up teammates.
